entities.name: Apocalypse
entities.description: The last novel of the Invasion Cycle, by J. Robert King, concluding the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault on Dominaria whose final stage is told in this novel.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The dark lord of Phyrexia who plans to cross over into Dominaria to claim it as his new home.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: One of Dominaria's greatest protectors, who joins Yawgmoth's side and later wins the duel against Urza.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: One of Dominaria's greatest protectors, who joins Yawgmoth, is decapitated by Gerrard, and survives as a head.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: A dead ally whom Gerrard wishes to have returned from the dead.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A golem whose memory cap has cracked after he broke his pacifist oath, and who becomes an accumulation of the Legacy.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A flying ship that merges with the Thran Tome, becomes sentient, and launches the Legacy Weapon.

entities.name: Thran Tome
entities.description: An ancient tome that Karn has the Weatherlight merge with.

entities.name: Bo Levar
entities.description: A planeswalker who discovers Urza's treachery and later sacrifices his life to protect the Eliterates.

entities.name: Commodore Guff
entities.description: A planeswalker who is a kind of editor of the Multiverse and who erases Dominaria's dark destiny.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A figure who helps set off the Soul Bombs and later erects a monument for the fallen.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: A leader who helps with the Soul Bombs and brings surviving minotaurs to Hurloon.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: A character whose death is discovered by the heroes.

entities.name: Soul Bombs
entities.description: Weapons set off by the Nine Titans, finally gutting Phyrexia.

entities.name: Nine Titans
entities.description: A group of nine, four of whom remain and set off the last Soul Bomb.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A being who lived in the Weatherlight's wood, returns to Yavimaya and transplants part of it onto Urborg.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Multani's home, which is safe from Phyrexian forces for now.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Land where Crovax rules from the Stronghold and where the final battle takes place.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: A land that has fallen to Phyrexian forces.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: A land that has fallen to Phyrexian forces.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Ruler of the Stronghold on Urborg, who is overwhelmed by Yavimayan forces and later killed by Gerrard.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Crovax's fortress built in a dormant volcano on Urborg, containing a portal.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: A leader who seeks a backdoor into the Stronghold and later dies with his army.

entities.name: Lin Sivvi
entities.description: An ally of Eladamri who dies with him.

entities.name: Grizzlegom
entities.description: A minotaur who helps seek a way into the Stronghold and survives to be brought to Hurloon.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A goblin who reunites with Gerrard and fries Ertai.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A character in the Stronghold who summons Crovax back and is killed by Squee's tampering.

entities.name: Null Moon
entities.description: A moon that has been gathering white mana for 9000 years.

entities.name: Legacy
entities.description: A collection of artifacts forming an ancient, untested weapon, launched by the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: A realm Urza wants to recreate on Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane under Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Yawgmoth's home plane, where Gerrard and Urza duel and which is gutted by the last Soul Bomb.

entities.name: Eliterates
entities.description: An artist colony protected by Bo Levar's sacrifice.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain who gets a new ship, later named the Victory.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A crew member who joins Sisay's new ship.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: A character who plans to marry Cho-Manno in Mercadia.

entities.name: Cho-Manno
entities.description: The man Orim plans to marry.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: A plane to which Karn takes Orim.

events.summary: Yawgmoth sets Gerrard and Urza to fight in an arena filled with his avatars, promising to grant the winner's wish.
events.quote: Their new master creates an arena which he fills with countless avatars of himself

events.summary: Karn reveals his memory cap has cracked and has the crashed Weatherlight merge with the Thran Tome, rebirthing it as a sentient creature.
events.quote: the flying ship is reborn as a sentient creature

events.summary: Bo Levar, Guff, Freyalise and Windgrace discover Urza's treachery and Taysir's death and decide to set off the Soul Bombs manually.
events.quote: They decide to set off the Soul Bombs manually.

events.summary: Multani returns to Yavimaya, learns other lands have fallen, and transplants part of Yavimaya onto Urborg, driving Crovax from his throne room.
events.quote: He flees to regroup his army.

events.summary: Eladamri, Lin Sivvi and Grizzlegom search for a backdoor into the Stronghold and meet dwarves planning to blast a tunnel.
events.quote: try to find a backdoor into the Stronghold

events.summary: Gerrard wins the duel by decapitating Urza, rejects Yawgmoth's reward, sees through a Hanna-avatar, and is flung out of Phyrexia.
events.quote: Gerrard wins the duel by decapitating Urza.

events.summary: Gerrard lands in the Stronghold throne room, reunites with Squee, and they defeat Phyrexian troops; Ertai summons Crovax back.
events.quote: Ertai realizes he can't defeat Gerrard and summons Crovax back to the Stronghold.

events.summary: Gerrard kills Crovax, Squee fries Ertai, and the Dominarian forces escape on the Weatherlight as lava engulfs the Stronghold.
events.quote: Gerrard kills Crovax with an axe

events.summary: The remaining Nine Titans set off the last Soul Bomb, gutting Phyrexia, but Yawgmoth has already left and arrives on Dominaria as a death cloud.
events.quote: Yawgmoth finally comes back to Dominaria, after 9000 years, in the form of a death cloud

events.summary: Urza's head proposes recreating Serra's Realm, but Karn tells of the Null Moon, and the Weatherlight planeshifts there to gather white mana.
events.quote: Weatherlight planeshifts to that moon and gathers the mana within

events.summary: Bo Levar convinces Guff, who erases Dominaria's dark destiny before the death cloud kills him.
events.quote: In his library he erases the dark destiny of Dominaria

events.summary: Eladamri, Lin Sivvi and their army commit suicide to avoid Yawgmoth.
events.quote: Eladamri, Lin Sivvi, and their army commit suicide

events.summary: The cloud kills the minotaur and metathran armies on Urborg except a small group saved by Lord Windgrace.
events.quote: brought to Hurloon by Lord Windgrace just in time

events.summary: Bo Levar sacrifices his life to keep the Eliterates from Phyrexian hands.
The Weatherlight launches the Legacy Weapon, Yawgmoth seizes the ship, and Karn, Urza and Gerrard merge into a radiant light that defeats Yawgmoth.
A year later Freyalise erects a monument, and Karn, as an accumulation of the Legacy, takes Orim to Mercadia while Sisay, Squee and Tahngarth sail on the Victory.
events.quote: One year later, in a ceremony attended by survivors from all over the globe

relations.note: Gerrard kills Crovax with an axe
relations.quote: Gerrard kills Crovax with an axe

relations.note: Karn becomes an accumulation of the whole Legacy
relations.quote: The golem reveals he is an accumulation of the entire Legacy
